headline: Helix Biosystems Opens Geneware Clinics — 'Upgrade Yourself, Today'
body: Helix Biosystems launched commercial geneware treatments at six licensed clinics across The Circuit and The Spires this morning, making GLMZ the first megacity to offer over-the-counter genomic augmentation to the general public — pending a 2,400 quanta baseline consultation fee. The flagship treatment tiers include HX-Lucid, a neural-sensitivity enhancement targeting memory consolidation and reaction latency, and HX-Forge, a musculoskeletal density package marketed toward Geartown industrial workers. Helix CEO Dr. Priya Sandoval-Ngozi told a packed press floor that the company expects to process 10,000 patients in the first quarter alone. Critics were immediate. The Collective issued a statement within the hour calling geneware 'a wellness system priced for the Spires and denied to the Gray Zone,' while three Federal Remnant health delegates filed a formal inquiry into the long-term liability framework — specifically, who bears cost when modifications fail. Helix's own clinical trials, conducted over six years at undisclosed facilities, showed a 94.2% positive outcome rate; the remaining 5.8% is described in the trial brief only as 'outcome variance requiring monitoring.'
aftermath: By 2122, black-market geneware clinics operating out of The Narrows were offering unlicensed Helix-derived treatments at a tenth of the cost, triggering a prolonged Helix enforcement campaign and a wave of disfigurement cases that became known colloquially as 'the Splice Bleed.'
runner_relevance: Helix's launch immediately spawned a thriving shadow economy around the clinics. Runners were hired for formula theft — competing corponations, particularly Axiom's biopharma division, paid heavily for lifted geneware sequencing data. Courier contracts emerged for discreet transport of black-market splice kits into the Gray Zone and The Narrows. Protection contracts guarded high-value clients traveling to clinics through unsafe districts. Once the Splice Bleed began in 2122, extraction jobs opened up around silencing or relocating disfigured patients before Helix's legal team could quarantine them as liability witnesses.
